title: Planning-Coding Separation in LLM-Based Code Generation: An Empirical Study
title_zh: 基于大语言模型代码生成中的规划-编码分离：一项实证研究

paragraphs.en: 实证研究表明LLM代码生成中规划与编码可分离，不同模型组合仍具竞争力。 Planning has been identified as an important factor for improved code generation with Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the interaction between planning capability and coding capability remains largely underexplored, especially when the two capabilities are from different LLMs. In this paper, we conduct the first comprehensive empirical study of planning-coding interaction in LLM-based code generation, where planning and coding are assigned to different LLMs (i.e., planning-coding separation). Specifically, we explore different planner-coder combinations to investigate the effectiveness for coders to utilize planning information from various planners and the impact of further training of coders on planner-coder combinations. Our results demonstrate that almost all planner-coder combinations are as competitive as using the same LLM for planning and coding, and the combination of a stronger planner and a stronger coder typically achieves improved effectiveness. Furthermore, using a large model as the planner paired with a much smaller model as the coder can sometimes be as competitive as using the large model as both the planner and the coder, and further training of the coder can typically boost various planner-coder combinations. These findings provide empirical evidence that planning and coding can be separated to a considerable extent in LLM-based code generation, which may offer a more flexible way to construct code-generation systems.
paragraphs.zh: 实证研究表明LLM代码生成中规划与编码可分离，不同模型组合仍具竞争力。 规划已被认为是提升大语言模型（LLM）代码生成效果的重要因素。 然而，规划能力与编码能力之间的交互关系在很大程度上仍未被充分探索，尤其是当这两种能力来自不同的LLM时。 在本文中，我们首次对基于LLM的代码生成中规划与编码的交互进行了全面的实证研究，其中规划与编码被分配给不同的LLM（即规划-编码分离）。 具体而言，我们探索了不同的规划器-编码器组合，以研究编码器利用来自各种规划器的规划信息的有效性，以及编码器的进一步训练对规划器-编码器组合的影响。 我们的结果表明，几乎所有规划器-编码器组合都和使用同一个LLM进行规划与编码一样具有竞争力，并且更强的规划器与更强的编码器的组合通常能取得更好的效果。 此外，使用大模型作为规划器并搭配一个小得多的模型作为编码器，有时能和使用大模型同时担任规划器与编码器一样具有竞争力，而对编码器的进一步训练通常能提升各种规划器-编码器组合的效果。 这些发现提供了实证证据，表明在基于LLM的代码生成中，规划与编码在相当程度上是可以分离的，这可能为构建代码生成系统提供一种更灵活的方式。
